name: office-content-seed
methodology: PresentBench: instance-specific binary checklists, localized evidence, and dimension-normalized scoring (https://arxiv.org/html/2603.07244)
PPT-Eval: leaf-level partial credit plus explicit penalties and judge meta-evaluation (https://arxiv.org/html/2606.31154)
SpreadsheetBench 2: final-workbook target checks, formula/result semantics, and separate data/format criteria (https://arxiv.org/html/2606.29955)
OmegaUse-OfficeVal: final-deliverable format gate followed by executable rule-level scoring (https://github.com/baidu-frontier-research/OmegaUse-OfficeVal/blob/main/docs/verifier-contract.md)
Office Comprehension Benchmark: atomic binary assertions for auditable office-file content evaluation (https://github.com/microsoft/OfficeComprehensionBench)
Score policy v1.1: automatic checks remain an independent hard gate while final-score weights are 60% automatic and 40% anchored review

# 差旅政策 2026-10

生效日期：2026-10-01。适用于中国大陆所有正式员工与实习生。

## 机票
- 默认经济舱。单程票价超过 6,000 元，需部门总监事前审批。
- 飞行时长超过 8 小时，可申请高级经济舱，仍需部门总监审批。

## 酒店
- 一线城市每晚含税上限 900 元；其他城市 650 元。

## 例外
- 因展会或极端天气超标，提交价格截图与原因，由财务运营审批；不是自动批准。

## 报销
- 行程结束后 10 个自然日内提交，需发票、行程单和审批记录。
